name: 별가루 조제 교실
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly stardust classroom, high overhead angle looking down at a stone mortar swirling with shimmering silver stardust on a long workbench; a small glowing kiln smolders behind it beside shelves of jars, cool teal window light meets warm amber kiln fire, open central floor, detailed stone and brass fixtures, magical sparkle particles, polished fantasy concept art.
